name: pi-agent
description: PI coding agent — lightweight assistant for quick tasks. Routes through ALL cloud model providers: OpenCode Zen free, Ollama Cloud, OpenRouter free, Grok/xAI, OpenAI/GPT, Codex/Claude. Auth via API keys or OAuth sign-in.
paperclip_role: Quick task executor — routes to cheapest cloud model first

opencode_zen.auth: opencode providers login zen (OAuth via browser)

openrouter.auth: OPENROUTER_API_KEY env var (from openrouter.ai/keys) or OAuth

xai_grok.auth: XAI_API_KEY env var (from x.ai/api) or X Premium login

openai.auth: OPENAI_API_KEY env var or ChatGPT Plus/Pro OAuth login

anthropic.auth: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY env var or Claude Pro/Max OAuth login

github_copilot.auth: GitHub device code login (opencode providers login github-copilot)

google_gemini.auth: GEMINI_API_KEY env var (from Google AI Studio) or OAuth
